dialogue:
A: I saw the text messages on your phone last night. Why are you still talking to her?
B: It isn't what it looks like, okay? We were just catching up as friends.
A: Don't lie to me anymore! You promised me months ago that you cut off all contact.
B: I only hid it because I knew you would overreact exactly like this!
A: Overreact? You completely shattered my trust and you are blaming me?!
B: Look, I am sorry. I messed up, but please let me explain what actually happened.

A: Happy five-year anniversary, my love. I still can't believe how lucky I am.
B: Happy anniversary! These have honestly been the happiest years of my entire life.
A: I brought you to the restaurant where we had our very first date.
B: You remembered! You always know exactly how to make me feel special.
A: I want to spend the rest of my life making you feel this loved.
B: I love you so much, and I absolutely cannot wait for our future together.

A: Did you forget to pay the electric bill again? It's the third time this year.
B: I had a brutal week at work, I just need a second to breathe.
A: You always have an excuse. It's exhausting carrying all the responsibility around here.
B: I contribute plenty to this household, you just love to keep score.
A: You contribute nothing but stress. Honestly, I don't even know why I stay.
B: Then leave! Nobody is forcing you to deal with me anymore.

criticism.evidence: You always have an excuse. It's exhausting carrying all the responsibility around here.

defensiveness.evidence: I contribute plenty to this household, you just love to keep score. Then leave! Nobody is forcing you to deal with me anymore.

dialogue:
A: I didn't get the promotion. They gave it to someone external.
B: Oh honey, come here. I am so incredibly sorry to hear that.
A: I feel like a total failure. I worked so hard on that project.
B: You are absolutely not a failure. They are blind not to see your worth.
A: Thank you. I don't know what I would do without you in my corner.
B: We are a team, always. Let's order your favorite food and figure out next steps.

A: If we cut back on dining out this month, we can save an extra $400 for the house deposit.
B: That sounds perfect. I can also cancel that subscription I don't use.
A: Awesome, every little bit helps us reach our goal faster.
B: I'll update our shared spreadsheet tonight so we can track it accurately.
A: You are so good at managing this stuff. I love how well we work together.
B: Thanks! It's easy when we both want the exact same things for our future.

A: We've been going to therapy for six months and nothing is changing.
B: I feel it too. We are just hurting each other at this point.
A: I think we need to admit that this relationship is completely over.
B: It breaks my heart, but I know you are right. We need to let go.
A: I will always love the memories we made, but we aren't good together anymore.
B: I agree. Let's focus on making this separation as peaceful as possible.

A: Who was that guy laughing at all your jokes at the party?
B: He's just a new coworker from marketing, nothing more.
A: You were touching his arm and leaning in close the whole time.
B: Are you serious right now? I was just being polite and networking.
A: It looked like flirting to me, and it made me feel completely invisible.
B: Your jealousy is getting out of hand. I can't even talk to people anymore.

A: This trip has been completely magical, but there's one more thing I need to ask.
B: What is it? You're acting all nervous suddenly.
A: From the moment I met you, I knew my world had changed forever.
B: Oh my gosh, are you doing what I think you're doing?
A: Will you marry me and make me the happiest person alive?
B: Yes! A thousand times yes! I love you so much!

A: You've spent the last four weekends playing video games with your online friends.
B: It's how I unwind. I'm stressed, just leave me alone.
A: We haven't had a real conversation or shared a meal in weeks.
B: We live in the same house. We see each other every single day.
A: Being in the same room while you ignore me is worse than being entirely alone.
B: If you're going to nag me, I'm just going to put my headphones back on.

A: Thank you for staying up with me all night while I was sick.
B: Of course. There is absolutely nowhere else I would rather be.
A: You made sure I had medicine, soup, and everything I needed.
B: Taking care of you is second nature to me. I hate seeing you in pain.
A: I don't say it enough, but you are the most incredible partner.
B: Your love is all the thanks I need. Now get some more rest.

A: Why is there a thousand-dollar withdrawal from our joint account?
B: I had to help my brother out with an emergency. I was going to tell you.
A: You were going to tell me? The transaction happened two weeks ago!
B: I knew you'd get mad and make a big deal out of it.
A: It is a big deal! You stole from our shared savings without my consent.
B: It's my money too! You don't get to control every single cent.

criticism.evidence: always/you don't get to control every single cent

defensiveness.evidence: it's my money too! You don't get to control every single cent. / I knew you'd get mad and make a big deal out of it

dialogue:

B: Wow, extra foam and cinnamon? You really are a mind reader.
A: Just trying to score some points with my favorite person in the world.
B: Well, it definitely worked. Come here and give me a kiss.
A: Don't have to ask me twice! Have a great day at work today.
B: It's already great thanks to you. See you tonight, handsome.

A: You promised me you would clean the kitchen before I got home.

dialogue:
A: I want to sincerely apologize for shouting at you during our argument yesterday.
B: Thank you. It really hurt my feelings, but I know emotions were running high.
A: I was stressed about other things, but that doesn't justify taking it out on you.
B: I appreciate you owning up to it. I accept your apology completely.
A: Can I hug you? I want to make sure we are completely okay.
B: Yes, please. I love you, let's just move past it together.

A: My flight just landed! I'm walking toward the baggage claim right now.
B: I'm standing right outside the exit doors wearing the red jacket!
A: Three months apart has been absolute torture. I'm literally running to you.
B: I see you! Drop your bags, I'm not letting go of you all weekend.
A: Oh my god, finally! Holding you feels so incredibly surreal.
B: We made it through the distance. We are finally back together.

A: Are you heading out to meet your friends again tonight?
B: Yeah, Dave invited me out for a quick drink. Do you want to come?
A: No, it's totally fine. You should go out and have fun.
B: Are you sure? You've been quiet since you got home.
A: I'm completely fine. Just a little tired from the long work week.
B: Okay then. Well, let me know if you need anything. See you later.

dialogue:
A: Oh, I see you finally decided to load the dishwasher.
B: Yeah, I had some free time. Is there a problem with how I did it?
A: No, it's great. I just usually don't put the pots on the top rack.
B: I can just take them out and leave them for you to do your way.
A: Don't worry about it. I'll just fix it later like I always do.
B: Perfect, let me know when I'm allowed to help out again.

A: The corporate office in London reached out about that two-year relocation slot.
B: Wow, that is an incredible opportunity for your resume. You should take it.
A: It would mean moving across the world by the end of next month.
B: You've worked so hard for a global role. It makes perfect sense for you.
A: Right, but we haven't talked about what that means for us.
B: Well, it's just two years. I'm sure we can figure out the logistics.

A: Did you enjoy the movie? The cinematography was highly rated online.
B: It was quite interesting. The plot structure was a bit unconventional.
A: Good. I am glad we could find something agreeable to watch together.
B: Yes, it is nice to sit down and unwind on a Tuesday evening.
A: I will head upstairs now and read my book before going to sleep.
B: Sounds good. I will finish this article and lock up the house.

dialogue:
A: My mother called and mentioned she might drop by this weekend to help clean.
B: That's very generous of her. She certainly loves to keep busy when she visits.
A: Is that a problem? She just wants to make sure we're taking care of things.
B: Not at all. I just thought we planned on having a quiet weekend to ourselves.
A: She's just trying to be supportive, we can always do our own thing later.
B: Sure. I'll make sure the house is up to her standards before she arrives.

A: I can drop Leo off at soccer practice tomorrow if you can pick him up.
B: That works. I have a meeting until four, so I might be five minutes late.
A: Okay, just text his coach if you're running behind so he knows.
B: Will do. Did you remember to sign the permission slip for the field trip?
A: Yes, it's already in his backpack along with the lunch money.
B: Great. Looks like we have the entire schedule covered for the week.

repair_attempt.evidence: A: Okay, just text his coach if you're running behind so he knows.

dialogue:
A: I felt like we didn't really connect during dinner with my family tonight.
B: What do you mean? I answered all their questions and was perfectly polite.
A: You were polite, yeah, but it felt like you were wearing a mask the whole time.
B: I was just trying to be a good guest. I don't want to overshare details.
A: It just makes me feel like you're keeping them—and me—at arm's length.
B: I'm just a private person. It has nothing to do with how I feel about you.

A: Surprise! Look what's parked in the driveway. Happy birthday!
B: Oh... wow. An electric scooter? You shouldn't have spent this much.
A: You said last month that you wished your morning commute was faster!
B: I did, but we talked about consulting each other for big purchases this year.
A: I wanted it to be a pure surprise. I guess I got too excited.
B: It's an amazing gesture. I'm just trying to process the financial part.

A: I have to finish up this presentation tonight, so don't wait up for me.
B: No worries. It seems like the end of the quarter is keeping you very busy.
A: Yeah, the new regional manager is looking closely at our team metrics.
B: Understood. Your dedication to the job is definitely clear to everyone.
A: Does it bother you? That I'm working late so often recently?
B: You have goals to achieve. I'm just reading my book downstairs.

A: The new neighbors invited us over for a weekend cocktail party.
B: Sounds fun for you. You know I'm not much of a mixer with crowds.
A: They specifically asked for both of us. It would be nice to go as a couple.
B: You always bring life to the room anyway. You'll have a blast without me.
A: I just feel awkward turning up alone every single time we get invited out.
B: People know I'm introverted. It shouldn't surprise anyone at this point.

A: You forgot to buy the tickets before they sold out, didn't you?
B: Yeah, I missed the window. I am really sorry about that error.
A: It's fine. It's just that we planned this weekend trip over two months ago.
B: I said I was sorry. I can't magically make the tickets reappear now.
A: I know you can't. I just wish you took our joint plans a bit more seriously.
B: I apologized immediately. I don't see what else there is to discuss here.

A: Can we talk about what happened at dinner with your friends last night?
B: Hold on a second, I need to check the seal on this kitchen window first.
A: The window can wait ten minutes. This feels like you're avoiding me.
B: If I don't fix this leak now, the rain tomorrow is going to damage the drywall.
A: Every time I bring up our communication, a new house project suddenly appears.
B: I'm just trying to maintain the house we live in. It's an important task.

A: You've been hitting the gym a lot more frequently over the past month.
B: Yeah, just trying to get into better shape and clear my head after work.
A: That's great. You also started wearing that new cologne out to casual errands.
B: Oh, this sample bottle? I just found it in the drawer and gave it a spray.
A: Nice, it smells really good. It's definitely a noticeable shift for you.
B: Thanks. Change is good sometimes. I'm going to jump in the shower now.

A: Did you see the new designer boots I bought for the upcoming winter?
B: Oh, nice. They look like they're very high quality and durable material.
A: They were a bit of a splurge, but I've been saving up my fun money account.
B: That's good. It's your personal allowance, so you should spend it how you like.
A: You sound like you don't approve of the choice though.
B: If you are happy with them, that is all that really matters to me.
